s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive facial swelling and sinus pressure with nasal septum deviation and proptosis
salient_findings: Heterogeneous mass in the left maxillary sinus with solid and cystic components
key_facts: Several months of sinus pressure and facial swelling
Several weeks of external deviation of her nasal septum
No significant past medical history
Left nasal mass noted on examination
Mild left-sided proptosis present
CT scan showed a heterogeneous mass in the left maxillary sinus
Mass eroded the orbital floor, medial and posterior maxillary walls, and anterior ethmoid air cells
Displacement of inferior rectus without muscle invasion
Left maxillary alveolar ridge and several molar roots involved
Bony changes showed remodeling and thinning
Biopsy showed spindle cell process with significant multinucleated giant cells
Rare mitotic activity
No cytologic atypia

raw.syndrome_frame: Progressive facial swelling and sinus pressure with nasal septum deviation and proptosis
salient_findings: Heterogeneous mass in the left maxillary sinus with solid and cystic components
key_facts: Several months of sinus pressure and facial swelling
Several weeks of external deviation of her nasal septum
No significant past medical history
Left nasal mass noted on examination
Mild left-sided proptosis present
CT scan showed a heterogeneous mass in the left maxillary sinus
Mass eroded the orbital floor, medial and posterior maxillary walls, and anterior ethmoid air cells
Displacement of inferior rectus without muscle invasion
Left maxillary alveolar ridge and several molar roots involved
Bony changes showed remodeling and thinning
Biopsy showed spindle cell process with significant multinucleated giant cells
Rare mitotic activity
No cytologic atypia

raw.rationale: The biopsy results showing a spindle cell process with significant multinucleated giant cells and rare mitotic activity are consistent with a giant cell tumor, which is known for its characteristic multinucleated giant cells and typically has a low mitotic rate.

rejected.label: Juvenile nasopharyngeal angiofibroma
rejected.why: This condition typically occurs in adolescent males and is characterized by a highly vascular tumor, which is not mentioned in the biopsy results.

rejected.label: Aneurysmal bone cyst
rejected.why: While aneurysmal bone cysts can have giant cells, they typically have a more fluid-filled, cystic appearance on imaging, which is not the primary description of the mass in this case.

rejected.label: Fibrous dysplasia
rejected.why: Fibrous dysplasia often presents with ground-glass appearance on imaging and does not typically have the significant multinucleated giant cells seen in the biopsy results.

rejected.label: Fibrosarcoma
rejected.why: Fibrosarcomas are malignant tumors that would be expected to have higher mitotic activity and more cytologic atypia than described in the biopsy results.
